{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Verify that 'customer_age' has no missing values in the full dataset
print("Missing values in 'customer_age':")
print(sales_df['customer_age'].isnull().sum())

# Verify that 'converted' has no missing values
print("\nMissing values in 'converted':")
print(sales_df['converted'].isnull().sum())

# Now, filter for customers who converted (converted == 1)
converted_customers = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]

# Check for missing values in 'customer_age' specifically among converted customers
print("\nMissing values in 'customer_age' among converted customers:")
print(converted_customers['customer_age'].isnull().sum())

# Compute the mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
print("\nMean age of converted customers:")
print(mean_age_converted)"}
